definitions.goer: a person who attends a specified place or event.
definitions.gore: blood that has been shed, especially as a result of violence.
definitions.gorse: a yellow-flowered shrub of the pea family, the leaves of which have the form of spines.
definitions.grope: feel about or search blindly or uncertainly with the hands.
definitions.peso: the basic monetary unit of several Latin American countries and of the Philippines, equal to 100 centésimos in Uruguay and 100 centavos elsewhere.
definitions.pore: a minute opening in the skin or other surface through which gases, liquids, or microscopic particles may pass.
definitions.pose: present or constitute (a problem, danger, question, etc.).
definitions.poser: a person who poses; a poseur.
definitions.posse: a body of men summoned by a sheriff to enforce the law.
definitions.progress: forward or onward movement towards a destination.
definitions.prose: ordinary written or spoken language, without metrical structure.
definitions.repo: a car or other item which has been repossessed.
definitions.rope: a length of stout cord made by twisting together strands of hemp, sisal, nylon, etc.
definitions.rose: a prickly bush or shrub that typically bears red, pink, yellow, or white fragrant flowers, native to north temperate regions and widely grown as an ornamental.
definitions.spore: a minute, typically single-celled, reproductive unit characteristic of lower plants, fungi, and protozoans, capable of giving rise to a new individual without sexual fusion.
